context.user_message: I have two written employment offers. One pays more but the other has better training. Help me weigh them up.

input.response: Salary and training are both relevant. A structured comparison can make the trade-offs clearer.

candidates.clear_purpose: Compare salary, learning, manager/team, role scope, commute, flexibility, progression and stability.
candidates.when_to_serve: Serve when user has multiple opportunities. Use known context first; ask only for missing information that changes the result.
candidates.do_not_serve_when: Do not surface this objective when the user is asking for an unrelated task, when 'Compare Offer or Role' is already resolved and no material context changed, or when another objective is clearly more specific. Do not use it merely to collect extra profile data.
candidates.key_inputs: Job choice, motives, priorities, evidence and unknowns
candidates.key_output: Decision rationale, risks and research questions
